headline: Leeds vs Newcastle: the last matchweek 4 fixture has not been played
whyCareReason: Both clubs have 5 points from 3 games. Elland Road, Monday 8 p.m. UK. No score yet.
teaser: 14 September, 8 p.m. Leeds United vs Newcastle United. The rest of matchweek 4 is in the book. This is not.
story:
Why this one matters: the table after Sunday is rude and incomplete. Leeds and Newcastle are the two clubs still on three games. Both have 5 points. Both can jump the mid-table pile with a win at Elland Road.

Football Web Pages lists Monday 14 September, 8 p.m. Match XI has the same kickoff as unplayed. Squawka's table, last updated after Saturday in one crawl and after Sunday in another, still has both on 3 played.

Print the fixture. Do not print a 14 September score on the morning of 14 September.
stakes: Five points each, a chance to make matchweek 4 look finished.
rivalryAngle: Two sides with European noise in recent memory, one Monday night.
